address: 208 rue de la Croix-Nivert, Paris, 75015, France
bio: In a downright convivial atmosphere, the chef – a former sports teacher who has chosen to branch out – prepares tasty cuisine that he changes up every day. He makes ample use of produce from South-West France (pork belly, pointed cabbage and green lentils), but also borrows a smattering of Asian ingredients (carpaccio of Tokyo turnip, crab meat, coriander and black garlic). An appealing place....
